description: Each invoice's cost ratio is its summed product cost ÷ its summed total cost.

a.request: For each invoice number in `Invoice_Line_Items`, give the invoice number, the invoice's cost ratio, its number of line items, and its relative ratio. To get the invoice's cost ratio, add up `derived_product_cost` over its lines and divide by the sum of `derived_total_cost` over its lines, ignoring missing values in each sum. The relative ratio is the invoice's cost ratio divided by the average of all invoices' cost ratios (ignoring missing values). Return rows only when that overall average exists. Sort by the relative ratio from highest to lowest, with missing values last, show the top 10, and don't round anything.
a.sql: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (relative_ratio IS NULL), relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For each invoice number in `Invoice_Line_Items`, report the sum of its non-missing `derived_product_cost` values divided by the sum of its non-missing `derived_total_cost` values, its line-item count, and that ratio divided by the average of the defined invoice ratios; exclude missing values throughout, return rows only if the overall average exists, sort the relative figure descending with missing values last, limit to 10 rows, and do not round
b.sql: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count, 1.0 * SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS invoice_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.invoice_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.invoice_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: For each invoice in `Invoice_Line_Items`, show the invoice number, the invoice's ratio of product cost (`derived_product_cost`) to total cost (`derived_total_cost`), how many line items it has, and that ratio divided by the average ratio across all invoices. Ignore missing values throughout, and return rows only when that overall average exists. Sort by the relative figure from highest to lowest, with missing values last, show the top 10, and don't round anything. Each invoice's cost ratio is its summed product cost ÷ its summed total cost.
c.sql: WITH invoice_totals AS (SELECT invoice_number, SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM invoice_totals) SELECT invoice_number, cost_ratio, line_item_count, cost_ratio / NULLIF(average_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM invoice_totals CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN relative_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: For each invoice in `Invoice_Line_Items`, show the invoice number, its cost ratio calculated as the sum of `derived_product_cost` divided by the sum of `derived_total_cost`, its line item count, and its cost ratio divided by the average cost ratio across all invoices. Ignore missing values throughout, return rows only when the overall average exists, sort by the relative figure from highest to lowest with missing values last, show the top 10, and do not round any values.
d.sql: WITH invoice_ratios AS (SELECT invoice_number, 1.0 * SUM(derived_product_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS average_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.cost_ratio, i.line_item_count, i.cost_ratio / NULLIF(o.average_cost_ratio, 0) AS relative_cost_ratio FROM invoice_ratios AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.average_cost_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY relative_cost_ratio IS NULL, relative_cost_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
